description: Compute the garden's rest-of-season planting schedule: every bed's next crops, chained forward to the effective first frost, deconflicted across beds with crop rotation and curated sow windows. Returns a PROPOSAL only — nothing is written; use add_planned_planting to accept a row into the succession plan. Returns every bed's chain, or one bed's full chain plus remainingCount for the rest when the garden's plan covers one bed.

garden.description: Garden name; defaults to the user's first garden.

today.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD to plan from; defaults to today in the garden's timezone.

name: get_season_plan
title: Get the season plan
